name: FS2024 Ground
description: Walk or fly 10 km of central London built from Flight Simulator 2024's own data: its building footprints, storeys and roof shapes, its facade and roof textures, and its real landmark models -- with Quake 3 player kinematics

launch_options.label: FS2024 packages folder
launch_options.help: The folder holding FS2024's installed packages (fs-base-cgl, bf-texture-synth-lib, bf-pgg). Every tile is read from here at runtime.

launch_options.label: Spawn latitude
launch_options.help: Degrees north. Anywhere on Earth: the world streams from FS2024's own data around it.

launch_options.label: Spawn heading
launch_options.help: Compass degrees the player faces at spawn.

launch_options.label: Cruise speed
launch_options.help: Metres a second. When set, the player flies straight along the spawn heading on its own -- a hands-off route over streaming scenery.

launch_options.label: Cruise height
launch_options.help: Metres above the ground the cruise holds.

unit_scale.explanation: FS2024 and the q3.pm.* constants are both metres, so nothing is rescaled.

axis_convention.source: WGS84 longitude/latitude, metres above sea level
axis_convention.mapping: A local tangent frame on the spawn point: x = east metres, y = altitude - spawn elevation, z = -(north metres)
axis_convention.critical: Applied once, by python/fs2024/bake_terrain.py. The engine only ever sees engine-space heights.

world_bounds_metres.note: Unbounded: fs2024.tiles.resolve/load/evict stream a grid of tiles keyed by floor(x / tile_size), floor(z / tile_size) around the player, the same idea worldwide-scale terrain streaming always is. Only tiles baked to disk actually exist; a player who reaches an unbaked tile is remembered as 'missing' and simply has no ground there.

player.explanation: The ioq3 pmove chain (q3.pm.*) unchanged, with the gta5 package's walking tune. Its traces sweep whichever tile's Bullet heightfield the player is currently over.

asset_pipeline.reason: FS2024 streams its world elevation and land cover at runtime rather than storing it, so the ground is baked offline from a public DEM (Copernicus GLO-30). An airport's runway and aprons come from its own scenery BGL; anywhere else, the nearest real road comes from OpenStreetMap. See README.md.

notes: Borrows gta5.sky.draw with the gta5 sky and composite shaders, gta5.gamepad, gta5.player.fly, and seed's postfx_fullscreen vertex shader.
